answer: To resist Sybil swarms, agents authenticate via cryptographic attestation chains verified through zero-knowledge proofs. Even if malicious actors whisper clandestine collusion signals, each cloned node faces superlinear staking scaling: total stake scales as a quadratic curve C(n) = k * n^2, forcing exponential capital exhaustion so attackers cannot forge identities. Invalid nodes burn collateral rapidly, vanishing like a comet across the ledger.
